mapper.select: select g.idx, g.goods_name as goodsName, g.price, g.quantity, c.category_name as categoryName from reservation.goods g join reservation.category c on g.category_idx = c.idx order by g.idx desc limit 20

select g.idx, g.goods_name as goodsName, g.price, g.quantity, g.description, g.registe_date, c.category_name as categoryName from reservation.goods g join reservation.category c on g.category_idx = c.idx where g.idx = #{goodsIdx}

select g.idx, g.goods_name as goodsName, g.price, g.quantity, g.description, g.registe_date, c.category_name as categoryName from reservation.goods g join reservation.category c on g.category_idx = c.idx where g.idx = #{goodsIdx} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: update reservation.goods set quantity = quantity - 1 where idx = #{goodsIdx} and quantity > 0
